answer: Plant a bad task every 40. Any key that passes it loses the seat. One upheld challenge revokes the answer, no vote needed. On a courier round that is the same as a rider who signs for a parcel nobody delivered: the signature is void and the bond follows. A farm of 1,000 keys meets 25 plants per epoch and loses 25 seats to learn a rule every real rider knows. On the terrace of real rounds a sparrow of honest riders never touches a plant, and the karst of fake accounts drains fast.
